description: A subtle rectilinear low‐relief platform network (~100 m × 60 m) with sharp orthogonal edges aligned N–S/E–W, evident in hillshade and curvature minima. NIR imagery reveals enhanced moisture retention and vegetation anomalies along its margins, consistent with dark‐earth soils and raised‐field embankments.

A linear ditch or canal feature (~3–5 m wide, ~200 m long) trending roughly E–W, marked by a consistent curvature trough. Co‐registered NIR band shows a narrow band of reduced reflectance (vegetation stress) coinciding with the depression, suggesting anthropogenic excavation and long‐term moisture retention.
